tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH Optical Fiber Cleaner MPO/MTP Type Connector End Face Cleaning Pen Tool is a high-performance fiber optic cleaning solution designed for MPO/MTP connector maintenance in data centers, FTTH networks, and telecom applications. This professional one-click cleaning tool effectively removes dust, oil, and microscopic contaminants from fiber optic connector end faces, helping maintain optimal signal transmission and network performance.


Engineered for both male and female MPO/MTP connectors, this fiber cleaning pen offers simple push-type operation for quick and efficient cleaning without alcohol or additional solvents. Its compact, lightweight, and durable design makes it ideal for fiber technicians, network engineers, and installers working in high-density fiber environments.


The OTECH MPO/MTP Cleaning Pen Tool is perfect for cleaning MPO cassette modules, QSFP transceivers, patch cords, ODF panels, and optical communication equipment, ensuring reliable fiber optic connectivity and reduced insertion loss.


Key Features


  • Professional MPO/MTP Fiber Connector Cleaning Tool
  • One-Click Push Cleaning Mechanism
  • Supports Male and Female MPO/MTP Connectors
  • Removes Dust, Oil, and Dirt Efficiently
  • Alcohol-Free Dry Cleaning Technology
  • Compact and Portable Design
  • Safe and Easy to Use
  • Ideal for Data Centers and Telecom Networks
  • Suitable for FTTH and Fiber Maintenance
  • Long Cleaning Life and Durable Construction
